Educational & Cultural Exchange Mission

Missions to Ramallah since 2015 for American journalists, educators, clergy and political leaders, plus graduate-student delegations, fellowships and cultural programming.

Branch
Leadership · A ladder by capacity
Owning entity
AFRP, with partner organisations
Shape
Cohort
Built in the Hub
Plan only

Who it's for

Journalists, educators, clergy, political leaders and graduate cohorts. How participants are chosen is an open question.

The operating year

Not stated in the record. Missions have run since 2015 and include taking part in the olive harvest.

The five rungs

Not stated in the record for this programme. The five rungs are hear, show up, take part, give or serve, and lead (D25).

Who runs it

The exchange-mission committee, which leads missions and administers the Palestine Fellowship grants. What it escalates is not stated.

Money

AFRP with partners; grant- and partner-funded. Figures are not stated.

Hand-offs

Fed by scholarship graduates and young adults. Its alumni are the natural recruits for Congressional Outreach.

What it needs

From the Federation's strategy
  • Missions, an alumni database, fellowships, an alumni newsletter (2019 plan, 2025 SWOT)
From the platform
  • Only a page, charter and plan exist
  • Fellowship applications are not in the record
  • An alumni database for mission alumni is not built; the match queue built so far covers scholarship alumni
  • Extra station for travel, and for minors abroad (Deep Programs)

Open questions

  • Does the exchange mission select participants, or take referrals from partners?
